### Danish Legislative Speech Corpus

::: {.meta}
1.7 million snippets · 1997–2024 · Harvard Dataverse
:::

Data set containing 1.7 million snippets of Danish legislative speech. Covers the
universe of Danish legislative speech, 1997–2024. Version 2 of October 2024
extends the data coverage to 2024.

Please cite as: Hjorth, Frederik, 2024, "Danish Legislative Speech Corpus V2",
Harvard Dataverse. URL: <https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PNCBKF>
